headline: Phantom Blade Zero release date
title: Phantom Blade Zero Release Date October 29 | PS5 and PC | Gaming News
video_script: Phantom Blade Zero is S-GAME's dark wuxia action RPG, built around fast, blade-to-blade sword combat. It releases on October twenty ninth, twenty twenty six, on PS5 and PC. It was originally set for September ninth, but was pushed back fifty days for extra polish. On PC it is coming to both Steam and the Epic Games Store. Are you waiting for it? Comment below!
description: Phantom Blade Zero (S-GAME) releases October 29, 2026 on PS5 and PC (Steam + Epic Games Store). It was originally due September 9.
